task: The implicit dependencies of the described ETL pipeline and a correct execution DAG.

criteria.text: The three extractions (sales DB, inventory CSV, customer API) are independent roots that can run in parallel.
Enriching sales with customer names and addresses depends on both the sales extraction and the customer extraction.
The stock-out risk computation depends on the inventory extraction and on the sales data (raw or enriched).

The daily summary depends on all three datasets via their processed forms (enriched sales, stock-out risk, customers); load depends on the summary; purging data older than 90 days runs only after the load.
The customer API's 100 requests/minute limit is treated as a scheduling or batching constraint on the customer extraction (its duration, retries, or caching), not ignored.
The DAG is presented explicitly (edges or a diagram) and is acyclic and consistent with the above.
